create_data_sampler: create a DataSampler instance with a dataset, framerate, batch size, and processing function
sample_batches_across_motions: sample shuffled batches across all motions and timestamps for training data generation
sample_batches_within_motions: sample batches within individual motions using probability-weighted motion selection for epoch training
sample_batches_as_motions: sample entire motions as individual batches for full-motion training iteration
get_toy_sample: retrieve a toy sample from the first motion at timestamp zero for quick testing
